name: graphql-core-incremental-executable-document-041d
instr:
GraphQL-core cannot reuse safe executable-document validation work across immutable revisions. Add opt-in incremental validation that reports reused and recomputed work while remaining equivalent to complete validation of the current document.

A session must distinguish added, removed, replaced, and unchanged executable definitions without mutating documents. Dependencies must be deterministic and unambiguous for document definitions, fragment names, operation roots, schema types, schema fields, and whole-document fallbacks. Every completed rule evaluation, including successful ones, must expose an immutable account of its rule, diagnostics, covered definitions, and consulted dependencies. `ValidationRule.validation_dependencies` reports precise dependencies through the existing context; omitted dependencies cause conservative invalidation. `ValidationDependencyKind` is a Enum.

Reuse work only when every consulted semantic fact remains equivalent, including field topology, fragment-condition types, the document-wide fragment namespace, operation-specific schema roots, and variable usage through transitively reachable fragments. Applying a revision returns an immutable `ValidationSnapshot` whose errors, ordering, `max_errors` abort behavior, and accounting match fresh validation. Export `IncrementalValidationSession`, `create_incremental_validation_session`, and `validate_incrementally` from both `graphql` and `graphql.validation`. Existing `validate`, `graphql`, `graphql_sy
